decontamination_inputs.a0_exemption: A_0's 1,008 TRAIN fillers carry 8 distinct 6-gram digests, of which 1 occurs in the DEV-1000 digest set and is therefore exempt. A_0 itself PASSES the gate; a filler shorter than six words yields no 6-gram at all, which is why 1,008 fillers produce 8 grams
decontamination_inputs.baseline_filler_texts: A_0's own 1,008 TRAIN fillers, which KC-S1b already sent and which are therefore exempt: refusing them would refuse the incumbent itself
decontamination_inputs.evaluation_ngram_digests: the committed artifact above, read through rails.proposer.load_evaluation_ngram_digests: 2,205 sha256 digests of the DEV-1000 sentence 6-grams (NEW500 contributes 1,133 of them, a strict subset). This is the route a FLIGHT takes. SAEA-SLURP-MF-EVO-DECONTAMINATION-V1 is the one row licensed to open SLURP devel sentence text and it has already spent that licence; a per-round candidate validation consumes its hash-pinned product instead, so no devel text is opened, held, rendered or logged a second time, and a refusal names digests
decontamination_inputs.evaluation_sentence_texts: the raw-sentence route, kept for the registered model-free row and for tests. A flight passes evaluation_ngram_digests instead; the two routes are unioned by rails.proposer.validate_slurp_candidate_artifact and decide identically, which tests/unit/test_slurp_proposer_family.py asserts
decontamination_inputs.exemplar_texts: the construction rows each candidate's proposer was shown; overlap is measured and reported, never gated
